2) **system_autopilot (system candidates spec)**
- Runs end-to-end system candidates defined in `experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml`.
- Produces system-level metrics; confirm whether any candidate beats the current champion on your decision criteria (you reported champion tuning_mean/min and lockbox_mean/min).

3) **aub_next_fix**
- Writes `baseline/reports/next_fix.md` with the next recommended remediation/work items driven by failures, regressions, or inconclusive spots in the registry.

Recommended quick sanity checks (optional but usually helpful):

```bash
git status
git diff
ls -lah baseline/reports/
```

If you paste the stdout/summary from (1) and (2), I can help interpret whether anything truly dethroned `baseline/champion_v5_latest.json` (especially watching for lockbox regressions even if tuning improves).
